style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

outcomes.required: A rounded, softly full cream speech balloon with a coherent readable rim and attached lower tail. The fixed target supplies fuller rim construction and dimensional icon forms; useful improvements are welcome within registration and identity. No dents, awkward tail joins, pinched cutout, pasted-on pieces or empty featureless dead regions.

Immediately read as scared/panicked trapped-customer feedback: one coral-red exclamation body with a distinct separate red dot, one small blue sweat drop, and restrained warm-gold emphasis ticks on ivory cream. Maintain clear symbol separation, familiar palette hierarchy, and the exclamation as the main read. Do not confuse it with preference, puzzled or happy feedback.

Warm cream midtones, gently rounded shading, restrained warm reflected rim light and legible soft highlights on balloon and symbols. Rim and lower shading must stay coherent with approved heart/smile family context without flattening panic emotion or becoming harsh black contour, metallic edge, bloom or external shadow.

Purposeful simple dimensional icon detail, clean gentle occlusion, interior breathing room and tidy tail/rim construction. No noisy ornament, text, disconnected unintended fragments, excessive tiny shine dots, blurry symbol boundaries or accidental surface defects.
